Maya R: agreed. Pin EU to v1.14.9. Notify #customer-success and schedule a follow-up in 30m
DeployBot: EU lanes pinned -> pinned_version=1.14.9 locked_by=DeployBot lock_until=1744447200
Ibrahim: APAC probe kept at 3% for now. If stable at +10m we can ramp to 6% then 12% sequentially
Tina (SRE): triage plan: 1) compare kernel/quantization selection between 1.14.9 and 1.15.0 2) inspect KV cache priming differences 3) check for recent config flips
Maya R: infra, please collect perf dumps and upload to ticket #INC-1744
Ibrahim: uploading perf dumps and traces, ETA 20m

Tina (SRE): if we can't identify root cause in 45m we'll escalate and open a postmortem
Maya R: thanks team. Keep this thread for updates only. If anything new happens @here. :thumbsup:
